Create an ORIGINAL game item sprite for the D'thorga hydraulic actuator: a hydraulic ram that lifts and tilts heavy machinery. Image 1 is our approved vehicle part from the same family: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy its shape.

Draw ONLY the actuator, alone on a plain pure white background, filling about 75 percent of the canvas. Square canvas.

A long hydraulic cylinder lying level: a thick muted olive-painted barrel with a shiny pale steel piston rod sliding out of one end, a round mounting eye at each end, and two small hose fittings on top of the barrel with a short black hose looping between them.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art. It must read clearly when shrunk to 64 pixels: three big shapes, few small ones.

No people, hands, animals, vehicles, text, letters, numbers, logos, dials, dust, floor, ground or cast shadow.
